newsitem.title: TURKEY: Second Kurdish rebel inmate dies in Turkey.
newsitem.headline: Second Kurdish rebel inmate dies in Turkey.

text.p: A second Kurdish rebel prisoner has died in hospital after setting himself alight late last month in protest at the deaths of 11 other Kurdish prisoners in a Turkish jail, a human rights official said on Thursday.
"Hamdullah Senguler died last night. The third prisoner Gulbahar Goker is also in a serious condition," Huseyin Aygul of the Human Rights Association told Reuters.
The three, members of the Kurdistan Workers Party (PKK) rebel group, poured paint thinner on their bodies and set themselves on fire in a cell at Istanbul's Bayrampasa prison 11 days ago.
One of them, Vedat Aydemir, died in hospital on Tuesday night.
They were protesting at the deaths of 11 PKK inmates during a riot at Diyarbakir high security jail in southeastern Turkey in September.
More than 20,000 people have died since 1984 in clashes between government and the guerrillas, fighting for autonomy or independence in the mainly Kurdish southeast.
